versions.changelog:
china-stock-toolkit v3.0.0

- Added news aggregation and sentiment analysis features for stocks, sectors, and policies.
- News are automatically labeled as bullish, bearish, or neutral based on custom keyword scoring.
- Individual stock details page now includes associated latest news and sentiment tags.
- Added scripts for news fetching, aggregation, and sentiment analysis.
- Updated documentation with new usage examples for news and sentiment analysis actions.

china-stock-toolkit v2.0.0

- Added support for global markets: Hong Kong, US, Japan, and South Korea indices.
- Introduced commodity prices: real-time gold and silver.
- Implemented watchlist management and detailed stock analysis features.
- Enhanced data source architecture for user-configurable global APIs.
- Updated HTML dashboard for multi-market display and responsive layout.
- Improved tax/fee calculation and expanded documentation.

Initial release of china-stock-toolkit — a real-time China A-share (A股) dashboard.

- Aggregates and cross-validates market data from Sina, Tencent, and Eastmoney.
- Monitors major indices, limit-up/limit-down stocks, and Northbound capital flows.
- Includes transaction fee calculator for buy/sell tax and commissions.
- Supports user-defined data source extensions.
- Provides an auto-generated, offline-friendly HTML dashboard with responsive design.
- Free to use, no API key required.
